notes.title: Car Abilities - 10 October 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119289/27534f6d31c15a9124beaf6cc7db82bc76e51c83.jpg[/img]

[h3]Tight Ride is evolving...[/h3]
Originally, we wanted to make the gameplay itself as simple as possible. Before this update you could play the game with one hand or even one finger *wink-wink, mobile version when?*. But the time came to steer away from our hyper casual roots.

In the last update we dropped the new vehicle, specifically to add more abilities this time
[list]
[*] [b]Buggy[/b] gets temporary Speed Boost with an Invincibility Shield
[*] [b]Rammer[/b] gets Knockback Waves
[*] [b]Thumb[/b] gets unique melee Saw Weapon
[/list]
[i]FYI abilities are activated by pressing Spacebar or RMB (X\A or similar on a gamepad)[/i]

Stay tuned for more updates as we fine-tune these changes.
In the mean-time be sure to leave any feedback you might have in our discord
[url=https://discord.gg/S8btnD3AcE]https://discord.gg/S8btnD3AcE[/url]

[b]- Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: Massive Weapon Rework - 12 August 2023
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, hope you liked our free demo.
In addition to it, we have been working on something else.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119289/e36b3d879bac475b982390244d153de60995ba1c.jpg[/img]
We reworked most of the weapons and their evolution to make the game feel more like Reverse Bullet Hell. Here are most notable changes:

[b]Turret[/b] - instead of one direction it can shoot in up to 5, depending on the upgrade lvl. This also affects Piercing Turret.

[b]Minigun[/b] - doesn't autotarget anymore. It only shoots in front of the car, so you have to keep it in mind while operating the vehicle.

[b]Vacuum Bomb[/b] - grows in size depending on the upgrade lvl + it auto collects all the XP shards and brings them to you.

[b]Shrapnel[/b] - instead of just exploding once, it stays in the same place and shoots projectiles multiple times.

[b]Prism Laser[/b] - chain attacks enemies if they are close by.

[b]Boomerang[/b] - multiple boomerangs are added with upgrade lvl. This also affects Curved Blades and Shuriken.

[b]Drone[/b] - multiple drones are added with upgrade lvl. This affects all drones.



And now we are in dire need of your feedback.
Are we moving in the right direction?
Should we even touch weapons or were they better before?
Is it worth investing more time into such changes or should we focus on content only?

Tell us what you think in Steam Discussions or in Discord [url=https://discord.gg/S8btnD3AcE]https://discord.gg/S8btnD3AcE[/url]

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - 01 August 2023
notes.content:
[h2]New crew member[/h2]

We had a Demoman crew member, but it didn’t really make sense for him to have perks that affected explosive weapons, but a fire weapon himself.
So we added a crew member called [b]Firestarter[/b] gave him Demoman’s Molotov and perks that buff fire damage.
And Demoman got a new team fortress like Sticky Bombs weapon.

[h2]Buildings and Obstacles[/h2]

Added a bunch of buildings so that arena doesn’t look so empty.
We are testing how will they affect gameplay and enemy behavior.
If it feels good, then we can start creating the lore around it and maybe start building different levels.

[h2]Demo Coming Soon[/h2]

We’ve been working a lot on a demo since the last update.
Originally we just wanted to upload one of the builds we tested before publishing the game on steam. But it had a lot of silly bugs, so it wouldn’t make a good representation of the game.
So we decided to just lock some content from the current build and give away that.

[b]-Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: Full Controller Support - 6 July 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119289/72de6fdb7bd525b6f83692f9432657b939a00a5c.jpg[/img][h3]This week we focused on one thing and one thing only - Controller Support.
There still might be some little bugs and UI inconsistencies, but overall [b]the game is 100% playable with any regular gamepad.[/b][/h3]

[h3]The work we've done also opens up the possibly of bringing our game to the Steam Deck later on. But we have to do a lot of testing before that and we unfortunately don't have the console on deck at the moment (:[/h3]

[b]Additionally[/b]
[list]
[*]Full WASD support. UI rework that we did for controllers allowed us to implement keyboard only controls
[*]You can now adjust the speed of the vehicle by moving cursor closer to or away from it
[/list]
[b]- Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - 27 June 2023
notes.content:
[h2]New Vehicle - The Rammer:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119289/c89ecb205e6739ca708716e6f8bda629c2d35733.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Introducing the latest addition to our vehicle roster, the Rammer!
[*] Unlike the Buggy, it does not feature a front weapon slot but compensates with an enhanced ramming capability, blocking ramming damage and delivering a more powerful impact on collisions.
[/list]
[h2]Steam Achievements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Integrated Steam API
[*] Added 4 initial achievements for unlocking 3 playable crewmembers and the new vehicle.
[/list]
[h2]Perk UI:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119289/1ac4f09e00d41b50abae4e7a91d21ffcfb1ce42d.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Tweaked Perk Cards UI and added categories to each card. Made them easier to understand at a glance.
[/list]
[h2]Arena:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We made the arena more visually appealing, fine-tuned the visual effects and adjusted the lighting.
[/list]
[h2]Level-based Bonuses for Vehicles:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now, with each level, your vehicle will automatically improve and gain passive bonuses to its attributes, making it more powerful.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay and QoL Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced attack token system for most of enemy types, meaning that they no longer can use their special attacks at the same time.
[/list]

We got more exciting new additions and improvements coming soon. Any feedback is invaluable to us as we strive to provide the best gaming experience possible.
[b]- Dev Team[/b]
